title: Recording, mixing: Magneto And Titanium Man, My Carnival, Call Me Back Again, Letting Go, You Gave Me The Answer by Wings | 1975
content:
Sea-Saint Recording Studio, New Orleans
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Alan O’Duffy, Ken Laxton, Roberta Grace

Wings worked on the tracks ‘Magneto And Titanium Man’ and ‘My Carnival’ on 14 February 1975.

Jimmy McCulloch and Denny Laine recorded electric guitar parts onto ‘Magneto And Titanium Man’, Paul McCartney added a Fender Rhodes electric piano overdub, and Joe English recorded more drums.

Backing vocals and handclaps were then added to ‘My Carnival. The song remained unreleased until 1985, when McCartney issued it as the b-side of the ‘Spies Like Us’ single.

Towards the end of the session, studio engineer Alan O’Duffy oversaw mixes of both songs and ‘Call Me Back Again’, ‘Letting Go’, and ‘You Gave Me The Answer’.
